styles.name: Vox Explainer
styles.inspiration: Vox-style animated documentary / explainer. Paper-collage of old engravings and halftone photos, masked and outlined; high-contrast serif type; one signature blue shape per beat; hand-drawn arrows; choppy low-shutter stop-motion with camera moves into shallow 3D depth. Reference images in references/.

palette.notes: 5 symbolic colors: warm paper, warm ink, brand blue (the eye-magnet), editorial red, cutout orange. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Fraunces (300 + 900 italic) is the statement voice; Archivo is metadata; Caveat is handwritten margin notes only.

styles.name: Kallaway
styles.inspiration: Kallaway-style premium dark creator explainer. Near-black cool canvas with a blue 'aurora' glow blooming from below; glassmorphism cards and pills; edge-lit neon frames; gradient glow text; focus-stack blur; smooth After-Effects easing (glide + bloom + breathe, never choppy). Palette is the brand palette — blue is the hero glow where the references used purple. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Dark cool canvas (#0A0E14 / deep #07121C), cream/white text, brand blue hero glow, yellow secondary pop, red/orange punctuation. One saturated glow per beat. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Plus Jakarta Sans (600-800) is the glow headline/number voice; Inter (400-600) is body/labels; Space Mono is data chips/timestamps/percentages. No serif.

styles.name: Keynote Minimal
styles.inspiration: Apple product-film / keynote graphics. True-black stage, enormous tight grotesk type (white or metallic gradient), one soft light source per beat, hairline dividers, silky expo motion, radical negative space. Reference frames in references/ (iPhone 17 Pro film, MacBook reveal).

palette.notes: Black + white carry 90% of the frame. brand blue is the single functional accent (one element per card). Copper/violet live only inside gradients and glows. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight 600-800 with -0.035em tracking is the SF Pro stand-in (headlines, numbers). Inter is quiet supporting copy. IBM Plex Mono is spec metadata only.

styles.name: Harris Atlas
styles.inspiration: Johnny-Harris cinematic map journalism. Aged parchment maps, sage oceans, slate country fills with white boxed Oswald labels, one blue-highlighted region per beat, typewriter metadata, film grain + warm burn transitions, slow documentary push-ins. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Two grounds: parchment/sage paper with warm ink, and projector-black film with cream text. brand blue highlights the one hero region/word; red is conflict punctuation only. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Oswald condensed caps is the cartographic voice (boxed labels, dates, headlines); Source Serif 4 is the narrative voice; Courier Prime is archival metadata.

styles.name: Fireship Terminal
styles.inspiration: Fireship dev-explainer. Near-black stage, cream Luckiest-Guy captions with fat black outlines stamping in word by word, JetBrains Mono code panels with pastel syntax colors and traffic-dot window chrome, neon wireframe title frames, flame-orange energy, meme-speed percussive pacing. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Captions are always cream with black stroke. brand blue is hero syntax + neon. Flame orange is the energy hit. Syntax pastels live only inside code panels and chips. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Luckiest Guy ALL CAPS with -webkit-text-stroke black rim (paint-order: stroke fill) is the caption voice. JetBrains Mono is all code/labels. Inter is rare supporting copy.

styles.name: Bloomberg Data
styles.inspiration: Bloomberg-Originals brutalist data journalism. Stark black canvas, white Archivo-Narrow caps in label boxes with accent underline bars, thin broadsheet rules, terminal-amber mono numerals, market green/red deltas, precise square-cornered chart geometry. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Flat fills only. Amber = numerals; blue = editorial accents (underline bars, chart keys); green/red = deltas exclusively. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Archivo 600-800 headlines; Archivo Narrow 600-700 UPPERCASE label boxes/kickers/axes; IBM Plex Mono for every numeral, ticker, delta, timestamp.

styles.name: Abram Optimist
styles.inspiration: Cleo-Abram bright tech optimism (Huge If True). Warm off-white canvas, big friendly Manrope 800 type, one prismatic gradient moment per card, springy pop entrances, light-leak flare sweeps, Space Mono tape-deck tags (REWIND <<). Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Light canvas always. Prism colors exist only inside the --prism gradient / wash / flare; solo accents are brand blue; sun yellow for tiny marks. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Manrope 700-800 sentence-case headlines and numbers; Inter supporting copy; Space Mono uppercase tape-deck tags in pill chips.

styles.name: Higgsfield
styles.inspiration: Higgsfield creator-tutorial videos (Ultra-Realistic AI Ads / Faceless Channel / Viral AI Short Film). Neon-lime accent over three canvases (near-black navy, dark-olive dot-matrix, butter cream), frosted-glass panels floating in perspective beside the speaker, staged grey-to-lime text reveals, LED boot cards, kinetic cream typography montages. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Lime #D6FD03 (sampled from refs) is the ONLY saturated color. Three takeover canvases exactly: navy, olive, cream. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight 800/900 ALL CAPS is the display voice. JetBrains Mono for pills, tags, eyebrow sublabels. Inter for rare supporting copy.

styles.name: L'utilisateur
styles.inspiration: Charte de marque (2026-10-01, 02_Contexte/Branding/charte-visuelle.md, univers Astral) appliquee sur la structure du style maison (derive de 09-higgsfield). Noir violet #06060C + grille violette fine, nappes de lumiere violette, accent lavande #A78BFA, degrade lavande vers #C4B5FD, Outfit + JetBrains Mono.

palette.notes: charte de marque (source : 02_Contexte/Branding/charte-visuelle.md). Fond noir violet #06060C toujours, grille rgba(139,92,246,.08) a 60 px. Accent lavande #A78BFA sur les mots qui portent l'idee, degrade #A78BFA -> #C4B5FD a 135deg. Violets #8B5CF6/#7C3AED/#6D28D9 pour boutons et tuiles. Plus de magenta, turquoise ni jaune (V1). Orange interdit sauf contenu Claude. Miroir de tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Outfit pour tout (400 a 900), titres ExtraBold 800 / Black 900, approche -0.03em. JetBrains Mono (400, 700) pour labels, commandes, compteurs. Fichiers .woff2 locaux dans fonts/ : aucune dependance CDN. Poppins (V1) reste dans fonts/ pour les anciens projets.

styles.name: Dan Kieft
styles.inspiration: The AI-filmmaking tutorial channel youtube.com/@Dankieft (refs pulled from 0B_xyflXrwc, UxwV16jDglA, e9ZupmL9BcM). Screens that stand in a room in perspective and are pushed into continuously, zooms onto a named region of a screen, prompt walls that get highlighted live marker by marker, a permanent periwinkle-ringed PIP, serif chapter titles. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Exactly three saturated colours: yellow (the accent), royal (the graphics stage), electric blue (the second marker). Two stages that never mix in one shot — royal for built graphics, charcoal for 3D screen work. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight ITALIC 800 caps is the signature — every pill leans forward. Instrument Serif is reserved for chapter titles and annotation labels, nothing else. Inter 24px carries prompt walls (small on purpose, it is a document). JetBrains Mono for badges and counters only.

styles.name: Nathan Hodgson
styles.inspiration: instagram.com/nathanhodgson.ai — the 'replayed tutorial' reel. Refs pulled from his last 10 reels (Aug 3-17 2026: DcJ0T19xsFx, DcHRrxNReQv, DcEfmJeutHp, DcCSsqsxGW8, Db_uV82x_2_, Db80jdBxmNc, Db6G_VhO8lh, Db3dRm9s1yg, Db1Ba0iu5fy, Dbydve0OqNc). Warm cream stage that is never flat, ONE orange accent, and interfaces that are REDRAWN (not screen-captured) and execute themselves while he talks: prompts type themselves, counters run, badges flip to done. Permanent top/bottom sandwich with a hard seam at ~52%, one-word pill captions, and the same violet Comment end-card on 10 reels out of 10. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: ONE accent only (orange). Green and blue are UI statuses, not accents. The violet gradient exists only on the end-card. Ink is warm brown-black, never #000. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Display = heavy grotesque CAPS, tightly tracked (-0.035em), titles only; numbers inside titles are orange and count up. Poppins (geometric) carries everything else including the one-word captions — it is what makes the style read 'product'. JetBrains Mono for values, counters, paths, statuses only, never a sentence. No serif anywhere.

styles.name: Nick Saraev
styles.inspiration: instagram.com/nick_saraev — the 'white gallery' reel. Refs pulled from his last 10 reels (Jul 30 - Aug 17 2026: DcJTgNZv3nW, DcEFABnvBuH, Db_H8ScP5y-, Db52rxbPh6i, Db3UttuvfwN, Db0zoZMPMCV, DbyJNRdPyCj, Dbvkxq3SAE0, Dbn6ElTvw_W, DblTPmfPCpB). Hard-white gallery and full-black stages, serif-italic-CAPS shock words stamped full frame, bold lowercase running captions, a coral pixel-art robot mascot that bobs between shots, and THE gesture: a REAL screenshot blurred everywhere except one sharp zone ringed by a thick neon stroke (orange/lime/cyan/red, one at a time). Real captures as evidence — never redrawn. Fastest style in the library. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: White is HARD (#FCFCFC), never cream — warming it slides into Nathan Hodgson. Coral is the only permanent accent (mascot + script voice). Neons are a rotation system for annotation frames: ONE on screen at a time, color may change shot to shot. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: The clash between voice 1 and 2 IS the style. Voice 1: serif ITALIC CAPS (Playfair 700i) for shock words, 1-3 words max, stamped full frame. Voice 2: bold lowercase geometric (Poppins 700) for running captions, 2-4 words. Voice 3: coral/white italic script for connectives, overlapping the other voice (the outro signature). Mono appears only INSIDE real captures.
